## Caption
Olga … It’s all just a game
But there is no Winner or a Loser 

Just a Player and NPC

NPC - stands for non-playable character. He has no choice - no freedom.

Being a Player - is all the purpose of living the Game.
And to Start your Game Now - just ask yourself- “Interesting if I have not had these limitations - what would I do next?”
